name: Mitten Extracts | 0.7g x 5 Infused Preroll Multi-Pack | Passion Orange Guava
description:
Bright, bold, and tropically vibrant, Passion Orange Guava blends citrus spark with lush island sweetness. The orange hits first with a zesty pop, followed by the tart passion fruit and smooth guava that rounds everything out. Expect a lively, energizing flavor that feels like a mini vacation in every hit.

Our infused pre-rolls are crafted for those who demand premium quality and bold experiences. Each infused pre-roll is packed with premium cannabis inputs, live resin terpenes, and liquid diamonds and then rolled in a kief coating. They deliver explosive flavor and unmatched potency, designed with a luxury ceramic tip for a smooth draw. Perfectly sized for convenience and ready to go wherever life takes you. Elevate your next session with Mitten Extracts infused pre-rolls—your go-to for flavor, potency, and quality.
